title: Understanding Uncertainty in Weather Forecasts
provider: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This short ECMWF learning module introduces sources of uncertainty in weather forecasts and considers how they can be conveyed through warning systems. The page describes a quiz-based learning check and places the module within the MedEWSa project.
license_evidence: ECMWF terms apply CC BY 4.0 to public website content without a separate rights notice, but the course content requires sign-in and its item-specific reuse terms were not visible.
notes: The public course description is visible without login; starting the course requires logging in or creating an ECMWF account.

title: Forecaster Training Course
provider: India Meteorological Department, Meteorological Training Institute
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This syllabus sets out the subjects in IMD's forecaster training program. It spans core meteorology and NWP alongside ocean-atmosphere interaction, remote sensing, radar, statistics, and computing.
license_evidence: No reuse license or redistribution terms were visible in the opened PDF.

title: Forecaster Training Course
provider: India Meteorological Department, Meteorological Training Institute
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
duration: 6 months (2 Months distant learning + 4 months classroom teaching) at Pune Centre and New Delhi centres
summary: This IMD program prepares serving meteorological officers to support forecast analysis, warning preparation, and climate services. It combines theory, practical examinations, field attachments, and a supervised project.
prerequisites: B.Sc. (with Physics or Math's as main subject) and successfully completion of BIP- MT course
license_evidence: No reuse license or redistribution terms were visible on the publicly accessible course page.
notes: The page identifies the target audience as Group-B level gazetted officers; it does not describe public registration.

title: Numerical Weather Prediction
provider: India Meteorological Department, Numerical Weather Prediction Division
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This portal displays IMD operational global-model guidance by forecast cycle and parameter. Users can inspect fields such as pressure, rainfall, marine winds, and winds at multiple pressure levels.
license_evidence: No redistribution license or reuse terms were visible on the portal page.
notes: IMD labels these charts as model guidance and directs users to its official bulletin or warning for the final forecast.

title: JetStream Max: Model Output Statistics
provider: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, National Weather Service
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This article describes how Model Output Statistics turn model guidance into point-based surface weather estimates. It explains forecast fields and codes while emphasizing that model-derived values are guidance and can miss local details.
license_evidence: The JetStream home page explicitly permits use of its materials in any manner.

title: Norwegian Cyclone Model
provider: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, National Weather Service
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: The lesson walks through the development and decay of a typical mid-latitude cyclone using weather-map and three-dimensional views. It connects frontal changes and upper-level disturbances with precipitation and the evolution of a surface low.
license_evidence: The JetStream home page explicitly permits use of its materials in any manner.

title: How to read Surface Weather Maps
provider: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, National Weather Service
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This illustrated lesson introduces common features on surface weather maps and explains how to interpret fronts and other air-mass boundaries. Examples connect a frontal passage with expected shifts in clouds, precipitation, temperature, and wind.
license_evidence: The JetStream home page explicitly permits use of its materials in any manner.

title: Weather Models
provider: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, National Weather Service
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This lesson explains how numerical models use atmospheric equations, observations, and repeated calculations to produce forecasts. It compares global and regional grids and describes trade-offs among grid spacing, time steps, computing needs, and forecast detail.
license_evidence: The JetStream home page explicitly permits use of its materials in any manner.

title: JetStream - An Online School for Weather
provider: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, National Weather Service
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: NOAA's online weather school organizes illustrated learning material into topic-based lessons and activities. It is aimed at educators, emergency managers, and other people interested in weather and safety.

title: Section: Topic 6 | Training | ETRP Moodle Site
provider: World Meteorological Organization, Education and Training Programme
subject: Weather Forecasting and Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This guest-access WMO training section collects readings, videos, quizzes, and online lessons relevant to forecasting. Its visible listings include WMO guidance on ensemble prediction and COMET lessons on NWP background and adding value to model forecasts.
